payload.reason: The evidence describes how audio and text sequences are combined in a dual RNN architecture for emotion classification.

claims.text: The model uses dual RNNs to independently encode audio and text sequences, then combines their information using a feed-forward neural network to predict emotion classes.
The audio-RNN encodes MFCC features and prosodic features, while the text-RNN encodes the word sequence, with their final hidden states forming separate encoding vectors.
An attention mechanism is proposed to focus on specific parts of the text transcript that contain strong emotional information, conditioned on the audio data.
